question: scan65 Yehi Khevod nor versus nur before Ashrei
context: guilt and does not destroy, many a time does He keep back his anger nor does He arouse the whole of His wrath. O Lord, save, may the King answer us on the day we call.
visual_evidence: The middle letter is a closed oval o, with an upper curved stroke. It is not an open-topped u. Both full scan65 and enlarged band2 inspected.
note: The question paraphrases the clause; this scan actually prints arouse the whole of His wrath, not stir up all His anger. No sic/corr is warranted for nor.
